title: Polynomial of the shifted coefficients
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer and let $m,a\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$. Form a new coefficient vector by shifting the coefficients of $a$ up one degree, taking the coefficient of degree $\ell-1$ in $a$, multiplying $m$ by that coefficient, and adding the two vectors coordinatewise. Its associated polynomial is $X$ times the polynomial associated to $a$, plus that top coefficient times $X^\ell$ plus the polynomial associated to $m$.
